source.name: FAOLEX Complete Collection
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
source.attribution: FAO. FAOLEX Database. Complete Collection. National vessel-related records selected from the source catalogue. Extracted 2026-11-23.
source.reuseNotes: The indexed metadata is adapted from FAOLEX and is distributed under the same licence. Rights in the linked national documents are held separately by their respective owners.

selection: FAOLEX country/territory legislation and regulations with controlled fishing-vessel, navigation, harbour or port-state keywords, or vessel terms in their recorded titles. Ports and inland navigation are included. Topics identify research candidates. The dates describe enactment or the last reported amendment. An absent repeal flag supplies no evidence of present force.
